# Workspace Orbit Preview 0.1.0

[Download the offline preview ZIP](https://github.com/afilen86/PortMap/raw/refs/heads/main/packages/orbit-preview-v0.1.0/PortMap-Orbit-Preview-0.1.0.zip)

Extract the ZIP in Finder and double-click **Port Map Orbit.html**. It opens in Safari or Chrome without installation or a server.

- **Light:** Clay Studio.
- **Dark:** After Hours.
- **System:** follows your Mac/browser appearance.

The package includes the standalone HTML, opening instructions, imagery notices, and a source manifest. It is a saved-data browser preview, not a native Mac installer or live device scanner.

Built from source tag [`orbit-preview-v0.1.0`](https://github.com/afilen86/PortMap/tree/orbit-preview-v0.1.0), commit `2002a96a8f3142982fdf63dcb41d5a0d323cde92`. This versioned ZIP and checksum are retained in the repository so downloads don't depend on GitHub Actions or the Releases API. Future versions should get new folders rather than replacing these files.

## Verify

Download the adjacent `.zip.sha256` file into the same folder as the ZIP, then run:

```bash
shasum -a 256 -c PortMap-Orbit-Preview-0.1.0.zip.sha256
```
